references_experience.text: ng Assisted Electronic Monitoring of West Coast Fixed Gear Fisheries. The Northwest Fisheries Science Center seeks a vendor to establish and refine Electronic Monitoring protocols for the fixed gear fleet that provide a full accounting of all catch. This requirement seeks to develop and implement comprehensive assessment techniques for quota management and integration into stock assessments. This acquisition is 100% set aside for small business concerns. The associated NAICS code is 541511, Custom Computer Programming Services, and the small business size standard is $34 million. Scientific integrity means the condition resulting from adherence to professional values and practices when conducting and applying the results of science that ensures objectivity, clarity, and reproducibility, and that provides insulation from bias, fabrication, falsification, plagiarism, interference, censorship, and inadequate procedural and information security. Presentation of scientific activities results includes the analysis, synthesis, compilation, or translation of scientific information and data into formats for the use of the Department of Commerce or the United States of America. Scientific and Research Misconduct means fabrication, falsification, or plagiarism in proposing, performing, or reviewing scientific and research activities, or in the products or reporting of the results of these activities. It specifically includes intentional circumvention of the integrity of the scientific and research process and actions that compromise that process, but does not include honest error or differences of opinion. This is a nonpersonal services contract requesting software development of Autonomy Government Reference Architecture (A-GRA) interfaces for the Mission Termination System (MTS), yielding a Technology Readiness Level 9 (TRL 9) product . MTS is a Run Time Assurance (RTA) tool based on the Testing Autonomy in Complex Environments (TACE) code base created by Johns Hopkins Applied Physics Lab (JHU APL). MTS is used at Edwards AFB to safely test autonomous control of small Unmanned Aerial Systems (sUAS). The government shall not exercise any supervision or control over the contract service providers performing the services herein. Such contract service providers shall be accountable solely to the contractor who, in turn, is responsible to the government. 1.1.1 Description of Services/Objectives. The contractor shall provide all management, personnel, equipment, supplies, facilities, transportatio

ion. 1.6.3 Delivered product shall integrate A-GRA autonomy interface into the existing MTS Service Set creation tool. Upon selection of A-GRA, the Mission Planner Autonomy UI must dynamically reconfigure connection parameter fields (e.g., IPs, Ports, Serial) to match the A- GRA interface format and auto -populate with appropriate default values. The delivered product shall include unique A-GRA–based service sets that preserve all existing autopilot and MTS configuration properties and differ only by using the A-GRA Autonomy Interface in place of legacy autonomy interfaces. 1.6.4 Delivered product shall maintain existing MTS Run Time Assurance (RTA) safety behaviors (e.g., geofencing, vehicle constraints, remediation) when A-GRA is the active autonomy provider and shall handle malformed or missing A-GRA/UCI messages without crashing or degrading RTA enforcement. 1.6.5 Product documentation (e.g., user guidance, configuration instructions, and build/install procedures) shall be delivered as part of this contract to describe how to enable, configure, and operate the A-GRA Autonomy Interface, A- GRA Message Processor, A-GRA service sets, and any other changes to MTS implemented under this effort, and shall clearly specify how the delivered product operates on existing MTS TA

Die Flyer beinhalten eine Übersichtskarte der jeweiligen Wege - führung, einen „Steckbrief“ des Weges und Tipps zu Sehenswertem entlang der Strecke. Zudem hat der Verband einen neuen Frei - zeitkatalog herausgegeben. Auf 78 Seiten werden knapp 200 sehens- und erlebens - werte Einrichtungen, Objekte und Angebote in der Region vorgestellt. Sie reichen von der Burg bis zum Bad, vom Kletterfelsen bis zum Kirchenbau, vom Theater bis zum Tierpark und vom Weihnachtsmarkt bis zum Winter - sport. Ergänzt wird das kleine Kompendium mit den Kontaktadressen der touristischen Ansprechpartner vor Ort, einem allgemei - nen Veranstaltungskalender und einer re - gionalen Übersichtskarte. Der Katalog ist in einer Auflagenhöhe von 8.000 Exemplaren erschienen. Alle drei Publikationen werden den hiesigen Tourist ­Informationen für ihre Auslagen sowie als Download auf der Web - site des Tourismusverbandes unter: https://www.tourismus-thueringer- wald.de/ prospektbestellung zur Verfügung gestellt. Include any dollar, schedule, or compatibility impacts if possible. Utilizing a different vendor or brand could result in significant schedule delays, as the government would need to evaluate, integrate, and train personnel on unfamiliar equipment. Previous experience indicates that such processes can considerably slow project progress. Additionally, switching to an alternative brand may introduce compatibility issues with the existing Crestron-based infrastructure, necessitating further technical adjustments, extended testing, and new approval procedures before the system can operate correctly. These challenges are likely to increase costs, compromise reliability, and disrupt operational continuity, making alternative brands both time-consuming and financially burdensome for the government. The resultant purchase order will be awarded using Simplified Acquisition Procedures in accordance with FAR 12.
